scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.test: bash -c 'export BAO_ENCRYPTION_KEY="${BAO_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-bao-test-encryption-key-32bytes}"; export BAO_ENABLE_AUTOMATION_VERIFY="${BAO_ENABLE_AUTOMATION_VERIFY:-true}"; export BAO_ALLOW_AUTOMATION_PRIVATE_HOSTS="${BAO_ALLOW_AUTOMATION_PRIVATE_HOSTS:-true}"; if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then if [ -z "${PLAYWRIGHT_HOST_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE:-}" ]; then export PLAYWRIGHT_HOST_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE="$(bun -e "import { arch, platform, release } from \"node:os\"; import { resolvePlaywrightHostPlatformOverride } from \"@bao/shared/utils/playwright-browsers-path\"; process.stdout.write(resolvePlaywrightHostPlatformOverride(platform(), arch(), release()) ?? \"\");")"; fi; case "${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-}" in *cursor-sandbox-cache*) unset PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH ;; esac; fi; bun test src'
